dimensions.assessment: Directly affects tax-exempt organizations under Section 501(c) with gross receipts of $200,000 or more or assets of $500,000 or more that make contributions to political entities.
dimensions.evidence: Any specified tax exempt organization that makes any disqualified political committee contribution shall pay a penalty equal to twice the amount of such contribution.

dimensions.assessment: Imposes severe financial penalties (100% to 200% taxes on contributions) and revocation of tax-exempt status for repeat violations.
dimensions.evidence: if such contribution is the first disqualified political committee contribution... there shall be imposed a tax on such organization of an amount equal to 100 percent of such contribution

dimensions.assessment: Increases federal revenues through new penalty taxes imposed on non-compliant tax-exempt organizations, though exact aggregate revenue impact is unspecified.
dimensions.evidence: there shall be imposed a tax on such organization of an amount equal to 100 percent of such contribution

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to add a new penalty section and new tax-exempt status revocation rules.
dimensions.evidence: Part I of subchapter B of chapter 68 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by adding at the end the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent tax penalties and temporary two-year tax-exempt status revocations for violations occurring after the effective date.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply with respect to contributions made after the date which is 1 year after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Projected federal revenue estimates from the imposed penalties.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill imposes federal excise taxes, penalties, and potential loss of tax-exempt status on certain tax-exempt organizations that contribute to political entities within two years of receiving foreign contributions.
